import json
from pathlib import Path
D=Path(__file__).parent
qs=json.loads((D/'contexts.json').read_text())
mask=lambda vs:sum(1<<v for v in set(vs))
def qexpr(q):
 vs,m,r,k,es=q
 rule='.'+k+(' '+str(es).replace('[', '(').replace(']', ')') if False else '')
 if k=='split':rule='.split ['+','.join(f'({v},{j})' for v,j in es)+']'
 return f'⟨{vs},{m},{r},{rule}⟩'
head='''import ScholzBrauer.ExclusionContext
namespace ScholzBrauer
set_option maxRecDepth 65536
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option Elab.async false
def bits : List Nat → Nat
| [] => 0
| v::vs => (2^v) ||| bits vs
structure BContext where
 q : ExclusionContext
 mask : Nat
 edgeMask : Nat
def fast (n : Nat) (lookup : Nat → BContext) (s : BContext) : Bool :=
 (bits s.q.values == s.mask) && (s.q.last != n) &&
 s.q.values.all (fun a => decide (a ≤ s.q.last)) &&
 match s.q.rule with
 | .invalid => false
 | .bound => decide (s.q.last * 2^s.q.remaining < n)
 | .gap => (s.q.remaining == 1) &&
   (activeValues n s.q 0).all (fun a => (activeValues n s.q 0).all (fun b => a+b != n))
 | .split edges =>
   match s.q.remaining with
   | 0 => false
   | k+1 =>
     (bits (edges.map Prod.fst) == s.edgeMask) &&
     (activeValues n s.q k).all (fun a => (activeValues n s.q k).all (fun b =>
       if s.q.last < a+b ∧ a+b ≤ n ∧ n ≤ (a+b)*2^k
       then s.edgeMask.testBit (a+b) else true)) &&
     edges.all (fun e =>
       let child := lookup e.2
       (child.q.last == e.1) && (child.q.remaining == k) &&
       ((s.mask &&& child.mask) == s.mask) && child.mask.testBit e.1)
'''
ids=list(range(7104,7136))
children=sorted({j for i in ids for _,j in qs[i][4]} | set(ids))
for mode in ['old','fast']:
 s=head
 for i in children:
  s+=f'noncomputable def q{i} : ExclusionContext := {qexpr(qs[i])}\n'
  if mode=='fast':s+=f'noncomputable def b{i} : BContext := ⟨q{i},{mask(qs[i][0])},{mask(v for v,_ in qs[i][4])}⟩\n'
 def look(js):
  if len(js)==1:return ('q' if mode=='old' else 'b')+str(js[0])
  mid=len(js)//2
  return f'(if i < {js[mid]} then {look(js[:mid])} else {look(js[mid:])})'
 s+=f'noncomputable def look (i : Nat) : '+('ExclusionContext' if mode=='old' else 'BContext')+' := '+look(children)+'\n'
 for i in ids:s+=f'example : '+(f'checkContext 12509 look q{i}' if mode=='old' else f'fast 12509 look b{i}')+' = true := by decide +kernel\n'
 s+='end ScholzBrauer\n'
 (D/f'{mode}.lean').write_text(s)
